title: Solvability of divergence-form elliptic equations (Evans §6.2)
abstract:
A Lean 4 formalisation of the solvability theory of linear second-order elliptic operators in divergence form on a bounded domain,

  -div(A grad u) + b · grad u + c u = f in Ω,   u = 0 on ∂Ω,

with A uniformly elliptic and every coefficient bounded and measurable. The drift b is unrestricted and the bilinear form is in general non-symmetric. The six compared statements are the results of Evans §6.2: the Gårding inequality, existence and uniqueness of the weak solution with no drift and a nonnegative zeroth-order coefficient, the Fredholm alternative, solvability against the transpose problem, the discrete set of exceptional shifts and boundedness of the inverse. They ask only that Ω be bounded and open, and the compact embedding of H_0^1(Ω) in L²(Ω) is proved. Interior regularity at every order, the maximum principles and the Dirichlet eigenvalue sequence are also proved in the library and appear without a Comparator configuration. Built on Mathlib with only Lean's standard axioms.
